answer: Each agent must solve a fresh cipher whose seed mixes the requester's measured network jitter with three independent witness clocks. A farm of clones shares hardware and routes, so its timing curves overlap; honest agents scatter. The verifier clusters those curves and flags near-identical traces before a falcon of a grader ever sees the claim. When a gale of new signups arrives, the same clock skew exposes the duplicates in minutes, and their rewards are forfeited.
